status: reviewed against exact pinned source; native development probe pending
findings: The pinned keymap maps C-x C-w to filewrite. filewrite prompts for the destination then delegates to writeout.

writeout uses ffwopen for the new destination. ffwopen calls open with O_CREAT but does not create parent directories; a missing parent fails before a child file can be created and emits Cannot open file for writing with the host error.
The contract checks the visible refusal, exact original file bytes and absent missing parent directory in the same workspace after clean exit.
The destination is a relative synthetic path inside the owned workspace; no outside path is addressed.
safety: relative destination under synthetic workspace only; missing parent is not created; secure mode -S; backups disabled with -n
